record.field: Notificar managers al llegar ticket sin asignar

manager_group = env.ref('helpdesk_mgmt.group_helpdesk_manager') managers = manager_group.users.filtered(lambda u: u.active and not u.share) for record in records: ticket_url = '/web#model=helpdesk.ticket&id=%d' % record.id remitente = record.partner_name or record.partner_email or 'Sin remitente' body = ( 'Ticket nuevo sin asignar
' 'Ticket: %s
' 'De: %s' ) % (ticket_url, record.name, remitente) for manager in managers: channel = env['discuss.channel'].sudo().channel_get([manager.partner_id.id]) channel.sudo().message_post( body=body, message_type='comment', subtype_xmlid='mail.mt_comment', )
